title: Scripture condemns relative image-cult too—transgressors meant to honor the true God through their images
source_text: XXVII. Praeterea Deum in isto mandato, non prohibere solum imaginum adorationem summam & absolutam, sed relativam quoque & subalternam, inde colligi potest, quod in scriptura multi graviter arguuntur, tanquam mandati divini transgressores, quod imagines fecerint, quibus verum Deum exprimi putabant, & in quarum cultu Deo vero religiosum honorem deferre intendebant.
pass_a_gloss: Besides, that God in that mandate does not prohibit only the highest and absolute adoration of images, but the relative and subordinate also, can thence be gathered, that in Scripture many are gravely argued, as transgressors of the divine commandment, because they made images by which they thought the true God to be expressed, and in whose cult they intended to pay religious honor to the true God.
pass_b_english: Biblical offenders often intended relative cult of the true God through images—and are still condemned.
So the mandate reaches subordinate/relative adoration, not only absolute god-cult.

lemmas.gloss: they thought the true God to be expressed
